chunks: He is the one who made you trustees on the earth. So he who disbelieves, will bear the consequence of his unbelief. but their unbelief will only increase disgust for unbelievers in the sight of their Lord; and their unbelief will only lead the unbelievers to greater loss.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of disbelief according to Surah Al-Fatiir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'khalifa' here is often linked to the concept of vicegerency, highlighting humanity's responsibility to manifest divine attributes on earth, a role ultimately perfected in the Imams. The verse underscores the cumulative nature of spiritual decay, where persistent disbelief not only incurs divine displeasure but actively increases the individual's own loss, reflecting the principle that actions have self-reinforcing consequences.
